name: ses-wear-test-firebase
description: Pruebas con los emuladores de Firebase: reglas de seguridad y Cloud Functions

scripts.test: cd .. && firebase --config firebase.pruebas.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-ses-wear "node --test --test-concurrency=1 test-firebase/*.test.js"
scripts.test:reglas: cd .. && firebase --config firebase.pruebas.json emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-ses-wear "node --test test-firebase/reglas.test.js"
